- Events: name, dates (start/end), category, location group, featuredImage,
  externalUrl, SEO, site relationship
- All collections multi-tenant with required site relationship field
- Admin panel groups all 4 under "Content" sidebar group
- Articles collection remains for blog posts only
- Migration 20260227_214422 creates all new tables with proper indexes and FK constraints
EOF
)"

---

## Deployment Summary

### What Was Built

4 new Payload CMS collections, all multi-tenant with a required `site` relationship field:

| Collection | Slug | Tables Created |
|---|---|---|
| **Suites** | `suites` | `suites`, `suites_amenities`, `suites_images` |
| **Reviews** | `reviews` | `reviews`, `reviews_highlights` |
| **Directory Entries** | `directory-entries` | `directory_entries`, `directory_entries_tags` |
| **Events** | `events` | `events` |

### Architecture Decisions
- **No enum conflicts** — used `IF NOT EXISTS` guards and kept migration strictly incremental (only new tables, no re-running existing ones)
- **Payload auto-ran migrations** — the container detected the new migration on startup and applied it automatically (the Payload service runs migrations on init)
- **Trimmed the generated migration** — Payload's `migrate:create` generates a full schema diff, so I stripped it down to only the net-new tables/columns/enums that weren't already in the DB
- **Restored the disabled 20251229 migration** — Payload's tooling re-enabled it; I re-commented it out to preserve the existing behavior

### Verification Results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/suites` | `totalDocs: 0` ✅ |
| `GET /api/reviews` | `totalDocs: 0` ✅ |
| `GET /api/directory-entries` | `totalDocs: 0` ✅ |
| `GET /api/events` | `totalDocs: 0` ✅ |
| `GET /api/articles` | `totalDocs: 91` ✅ (existing data intact) |
| Admin panel `https://cms.sonomagrovesuites.com/admin` | `HTTP 200` ✅ |
| Migration `20260227_214422` in `payload_migrations` | Applied at `2026-02-27 21:51:49` ✅ |
| All 8 new DB tables | Present in `public` schema ✅ |

### Next Steps (per the spec — separate prompts)
1. Update frontend `payload.ts` to query new endpoints instead of filtering articles by category slug
2. Seed the 3 suite records (Cabernet, Pinot, Chardonnay)
3. Re-upload ~168 guest reviews with suite relationships
4. Re-upload ~40 directory entries with structured location/contact data
5. Re-upload ~22 events with proper date fields
6. Clean up non-blog content from the `articles` collection
